title: Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
author: D. A. Yarotsky
read_scope: Definitions and Theorems 1-3, printed pages 2-4; Section 2 expansion outline inspected through web source, not independently reconstructed

bindings.paraphrase: The site Hilbert space may have infinite dimension; the onsite operator may be unbounded but is nonnegative and self-adjoint, with one vacuum and gap at least one.
bindings.application: Each coarse site is L2(SU(2)^24), with a shifted strip plus fourteen free Casimirs normalized by alpha/8.

bindings.paraphrase: Each perturbation is bounded self-adjoint and supported on a translate of a single fixed finite set.
bindings.application: All 21 omitted faces based in one tail block fit in S={0,e_x,e_y,e_z}; their normalized sum has norm 7|tau|.

bindings.paraphrase: The empty boundary prescription retains an anchor term only if the whole declared range translate lies inside the volume.
bindings.application: Use the whole-star prescription for the source thermodynamic limit; actual-support finite boundaries need an explicit padding argument.

bindings.paraphrase: For sufficiently small local perturbation the finite ground state is unique and the gap is bounded below uniformly in volume by one minus a range-dependent constant times the perturbation size.
bindings.application: Require 7|tau|<c1(S) and 7*c2(S)*|tau|<1/2 to get physical lower bound alpha/16. No numeric c1/c2 is supplied.

bindings.paraphrase: The finite-volume ground states converge locally; their limiting state defines a GNS representation with a self-adjoint limiting generator retaining the gap estimate.
bindings.application: Embed the positive coarse orthant in Z^3 with decoupled spectator sites outside it. Restrict the resulting limiting state and vacuum generator to the orthant.

bindings.paraphrase: Translation invariance is added for the later quasiparticle claims.
bindings.application: Do not require it for Theorems 1-3 and do not import quasiparticle dispersion or scattering conclusions.

source_access: Downloaded and read; full paper retained outside repository, not required by arithmetic replay.
